newsitem.title: USA: N Calif basketball team seeks new arena plan-paper.
newsitem.headline: N Calif basketball team seeks new arena plan-paper.

text.p: Golden State Warriors basketball team wants to scrap plans to sell expensive "personal seat licenses" at the newly remodeled Coliseum arena, San Jose Mercury News reported Thursday.

Warriors owner Chris Cohan said he would instead provide Oakland and Alameda County the $25 million that they hoped to earn by selling seat rights to help finance the $140 million deal that expands the arena and keeps the National Basketball Association team in Oakland, the newspaper said.
Cohan was not immediately available to comment on the newspaper report.
Cohan said he was worried that seat licenses would turn off some fans and noted the problems the Oakland Raiders have had selling seat licenses, the newspaper said.

Cohan hopes to make up for the $25 million payment with more ticket sales and profits from other arena events, the newspaper said. The Warriors also plan to raise ticket prices for the 1997 season and boost revenues from luxury suites and club seats.
